d: Every promising sighting brings Jeremy Wade closer to an answer, but not every search leads to the discovery he hopes for! From the giant Pacific halibut in Alaska and the seven-foot wels catfish to the mysterious Dusky Carp and the Giant Pike Menace, Jeremy investigates extraordinary fish reports across rivers, lakes and open waters. He also examines killer whales hunting salmon and tracks aquatic mysteries around Lake Garda and the Fitzroy River.
